mapper.select:
WITH base_data AS ( SELECT '0' AS "CHECKED" , im.company_code AS "COMPANY_CODE" , id.division_code AS "DIVISION_CODE" , d.division_name AS "DIVISION_NAME" , id.item_code AS "ITEM_CODE" , im.item_name AS "ITEM_NAME" , v.vendor_code AS "VENDOR_CODE" , v.vendor_name AS "VENDOR_NAME" , im.hs_code AS "HS_CODE" , CASE WHEN eccm.submit_status = '4' AND COALESCE(eccm.cnt, 0) <> 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "CNT"
FROM ext_cover_coo_item ecci
INNER JOIN item_dtl id ON ecci.company_code = id.company_code AND ecci.division_code = id.division_code AND ecci.item_code = id.item_code
INNER JOIN item_mst im ON id.company_code = im.company_code AND id.item_code = im.item_code
INNER JOIN vendor v ON ecci.company_code = v.company_code AND ecci.vendor_code = v.vendor_code
INNER JOIN division d ON id.company_code = d.company_code AND id.division_code = d.division_code
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT b.company_code , b.division_code , b.vendor_code , b.item_code , COUNT(*)::NUMERIC / NULLIF( COUNT(DISTINCT b.fta_code)::NUMERIC, 0 ) AS cnt , a.submit_status
FROM ext_coo_certify_mst a
INNER JOIN ext_coo_certify_dtl b ON a.company_code = b.company_code AND a.coo_certify_no = b.coo_certify_no AND a.vendor_code = b.vendor_code AND a.division_code = b.division_code
WHERE a.company_code = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND a.delete_yn = 'N' AND a.coo_certify_type = 'C'
AND b.apply_date <= #{SCH_APPLY_DATE} AND b.end_date >= #{SCH_APPLY_DATE}
GROUP BY b.company_code , b.division_code , b.vendor_code , b.item_code , a.submit_status
) eccm ON ecci.company_code = eccm.company_code AND ecci.division_code = eccm.division_code AND ecci.vendor_code = eccm.vendor_code AND ecci.item_code = eccm.item_code
WHERE ecci.company_code = #{COMPANY_CODE}
AND id.division_code = #{SEARCH_DIVISION_CODE}
AND ${search_type} LIKE '%' || #{search_key_word} || '%'
),
summary_data AS ( SELECT base_data.* , COUNT(*) OVER () AS "TOTAL_COUNT" , SUM( CASE WHEN "CNT" = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) OVER () AS "RECEIPT_COUNT" , ROUND( SUM( CASE WHEN "CNT" = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) OVER ()::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*) OVER (), 0) * 100 , 1 ) AS "RECEIPT_RATE" FROM base_data )
SELECT * FROM summary_data WHERE 1 = 1
AND "CNT" = #{cover_yn}
ORDER BY "DIVISION_CODE" , "VENDOR_CODE" , "ITEM_CODE"
